title: Scalar sections under a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], e : P ≅ Q a scheme isomorphism [def-pc-scheme], s : Q → Spec k a structure morphism, and U an open of Q. The tensor pullback functor e* [def-pc-module-pullback], followed by k-linear sections on e⁻¹(U) using e followed by s [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], is naturally isomorphic to k-linear sections on U using s. No quasi-coherence, affineness, or nonempty-open assumption is required.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Lemma 6.26.3 (module pullback and pushforward composition); Tag 00A0, Lemma 6.31.1 (open-immersion restriction). Read online 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Pushforward along the scheme isomorphism is fully faithful by the open-immersion restriction adjunction. Every module is in its essential image: pushforward along the inverse followed by pushforward along the forward map is isomorphic to the identity by composition and the inverse-hom identity. The tensor pullback adjunction unit is therefore an isomorphism on every module. The composition maps here are Mathlib pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr, and pushforwardId; full and faithful instances come from Mathlib restrictAdjunction. No project tensor-pullback identity/composition or restriction-comparison theorem is applied.

Evaluate the adjunction unit over U, obtaining a bijective map from sections on Q to sections of the pulled-back module on the inverse-image open. The scalarMap for the composite structure morphism is the section-ring map composed with scalarMap on Q; this follows by writing scalarMap using appLE and using appLE_comp_appLE. The unit component is thus k-linear.

The naturality square is the adjunction unit naturality square evaluated over U. Make each k-linear bijection an isomorphism with ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective, assemble with NatIso.ofComponents and invert the resulting natural isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Adjunction reformulation of module restriction transport from Tags 0097 and 00A0; scalar linearity by composition of structure-ring maps.

theorem scalarSections_iso_transport
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {P Q : Scheme.{w}} (e : P ≅ Q)
    (s : Q ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (U : Q.Opens) :
    Nonempty (tensorPullback e.hom ⋙
      picardScalarSectionsFunctor (e.hom ≫ s) (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≅
      picardScalarSectionsFunctor s U)
